layout.note: All 39 sources are placed once, in order: 264 output rows, 258 of them carrying Arabic and Persian together. Piece lengths run 34 code points at the median, inside the manual-v1 range. No crossed pairings, no orphaned one-word heading rows and no detached section labels were left behind. Rows were checked against the source in sampled groups by genre, and every item against the corpus-wide statistics.
